title: Line-ending *.py carve-out and .gitattributes drift in the standard and tooling
cluster_summary: v2.61.0 widened line-endings-§3 to require both *.sh and *.py text eol=lf. The standard's own .gitattributes and five whole-body restatements were never updated, and neither was dev-copilot's audit agent check (c). The root-cause fix is a single WowAddonStandards commit: replace .gitattributes with the line-endings-§5 non-client body byte-for-byte (WAS-R-01 + WAS-A-04), and fix the five enumerations, preferably by citing line-endings-§3 instead of restating it (WAS-R-02 absorbs WAS-A-05/06/07). The same commit can harden check (e) quoting and scope the §7 EOL-gate MUST. dev-copilot then needs one follow-up edit to its agent spec, covering check (c) and the check (e) quoting copy. Nothing breaks at runtime: no collection repo tracks a .py file, so everything here is low severity.

verdicts.assessment: Verified drift: the old shell-scripts comment is still there and the *.py line is missing, while line 6 claims the file is byte-identical. This is the reference repo, so its copy gets copied onward. The repo has no .py or .sh files, so there is no runtime effect, which drops severity from medium to low.
verdicts.remediation: Replace /.gitattributes with the line-endings-§5 non-client body byte-for-byte, then run git add --renormalize . (expect nothing staged). One commit carries WAS-R-01 + WAS-A-04.

verdicts.assessment: Same defect as WAS-R-01, found by the audit lane.
verdicts.remediation: Lands in the WAS-R-01 commit (shared id).

verdicts.assessment: Five of the seven sites restate the whole body without *.py: documentation.md:675, NEW_ADDON.md:20, NEW_ADDON_CONTEXT.md:1622, EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md:52 and CLAUDE.md:123. library-stack.md:221 and automated-tests.md:60-64 cite the *.sh carve-out only to protect run-automated-tests.sh, which I checked, so they are accurate. This is the root cause of the derived findings, and the fix is cheap.
verdicts.remediation: In one commit, name both *.sh and *.py carve-outs at the five sites, or replace each enumeration with a citation of line-endings-§3 so the next widening cannot drift. Leave library-stack.md:221 and automated-tests.md:60-64 as they are. Carries WAS-A-05, WAS-A-06 and WAS-A-07.

verdicts.assessment: documentation.md:675 is one of the WAS-R-02 sites. Real, but no separate work.
verdicts.remediation: Fixed in the WAS-R-02 commit (shared id).

verdicts.assessment: The 'canonical body' claims in CLAUDE.md:47, README.md:140 and DEPENDENCIES.md:63-65 become true once WAS-R-01 lands. The only edit is the CLAUDE.md:123-124 enumeration, which WAS-R-02 already covers.
verdicts.remediation: No standalone work. Resolved by WAS-R-01 (the claims become true) plus WAS-R-02 (CLAUDE.md:123-124 gains *.py). Re-verify the claims after both land.

verdicts.assessment: EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md:52 is one of the WAS-R-02 sites.
verdicts.remediation: Fixed in the WAS-R-02 commit (shared id).

verdicts.assessment: agents/wow-standards-audit.md:343 enumerates only *.sh. The fetched AUDIT.md (c) grep reduces the impact but does not remove it, because an agent reasoning from its own spec could pass a repo that is missing *.py. One-line fix.
verdicts.remediation: Rewrite check (c) to name both carve-outs, or to defer to 'the line-endings-§3 carve-outs per AUDIT.md (c)' instead of enumerating them.

verdicts.assessment: This is a real injection pattern, but it is latent: no such file names exist, and the inputs are the owner's own tracked files. There is also a third copy, in dev-copilot/agents/wow-standards-audit.md:347. It is cheap to fix while these files are open for WAS-R-02.
verdicts.remediation: In AUDIT.md:184-189 and line-endings.md:486-491, pass the path positionally with xargs -0 -n1 sh -c '... "$1" ...' _ instead of splicing "{}" into the script text. Mirror the same change in dev-copilot/agents/wow-standards-audit.md check (e), alongside DC-A-10.

verdicts.assessment: The contradiction is real. line-endings-§7 says 'Every repo MUST carry' tests/_kit/test_eol.lua, but documentation-and-tooling repos run no suite. I checked: neither WowAddonStandards nor dev-copilot has a tests/ directory. The fix is in the standard, not in dev-copilot. It was ungraded and has no runtime impact.
verdicts.remediation: Scope the line-endings-§7 EOL-gate MUST to repos where the testing section applies, and state that suite-less documentation-and-tooling repos rely on the hand check (e). No change in dev-copilot.
